TP_CANNOT_AUTOCLOSE_ERROR: You can use this function only if the current patch has exactly 1 point and it is on an anchor
IS_MERGE_TOOLTIP: Merges the two roads into one road with the settings of this one, and deletes the intersection (only the geometry of the other road is reversed if needed: its left and right properties are not swapped; the merged road keeps the curve type of this one, following the shape of both roads as closely as it can)
IS_SEAMLESS_TOOLTIP: The two roads join without a surface between them: the intersection has no size and no crosswalks, and the ends of the roads share their direction and roll (no yaw). Only with two roads
RD_EDIT_INTERSECTION_TOOLTIP: Opens the editor of the intersection this end of the road is on
RD_IS_CONN_AUTO_TOOLTIP: Takes the height of the other roads on the intersection (the plane through their ends), plus the value set
BATCH_ERROR_UPDATE: Syntax error in the update expression
BATCH_ERROR_WHERE: Syntax error in the where expression
BATCH_ERROR_RUNTIME: Runtime error, check the console for details
TP_DELETE_BORDER_MESH_WARNING: Are you sure you want to remove the selected border mesh?
POINT_ATTACH_TOOLTIP: Click an anchor or segment. Building points can also follow terrain patch corners and edges. Press Escape to cancel.
POINT_DETACH_TOOLTIP: Stop following the anchor, keeping this point and its shared references
POINT_PICKING: Click an anchor or segment (Escape to cancel)
POINT_ON_COLUMN: Attached to the vertical line of a point
POINT_ATTACH_CUSTOM_ELEMENT_TOOLTIP: Click a point (this point follows it, keeping its own shared references), an anchor or a segment. Press Escape to cancel.
POINT_ATTACH_LINE_TOOLTIP: Click two points: this point follows the line between them. Press Escape to cancel.
POINT_ATTACH_COLUMN_TOOLTIP: Click a point: this point follows its vertical line, keeping its own height. Press Escape to cancel.
POINT_PICKING_CUSTOM_ELEMENT: Click a point, an anchor or a segment (Escape to cancel)
POINT_PICKING_LINE_START: Click the first end of the line (Escape to cancel)
POINT_PICKING_LINE_END: Click the second end of the line (Escape to cancel)
POINT_PICKING_COLUMN: Click the point whose vertical line to follow (Escape to cancel)
TRANSF_P_YAW_TOOLTIP: Rotation of the road sections at this point around the vertical axis, in degrees (positive to the right). The road keeps its width. Not available at an end on an intersection, or if the road type doesn't allow it.
TRANSF_P_ROLL_TOOLTIP: Banking of the road sections at this point, in degrees (positive raises the right side). Not available if the road type doesn't allow it.
TRANSF_P_ROTATE_POINT_TOOLTIP: Rotate the sections at this point with the gizmo (yaw and roll, relative to the direction of the road)
BL_CANNOT_AUTOCLOSE_ERROR: You can use this function only if the current line has exactly 1 point and it is between two anchors
BL_NEED_PRESETS_FOR_AUTOCLOSE: To use this function you must add at least a preset in the random presets list
CB_NEED_LINE_PRESET: No building line preset selected. Select one and retry.
CB_NULL_ONLY: Place only on invisible terrain patches
CITY_ROTATION_ANGLES_MISSING: Select a rotation angle from the dropdown to continue
MIGRATION_ERROR_CORE_IS_FOR_NEWER_PROGRA: The core is for a newer version of the city builder, please update it before retrying.
MIGRATION_ERROR_CORE_IS_FOR_OLDER_PROGRA: The core is for an older version of the city builder, it has to be updated to support the current version.
MIGRATION_ERROR_CITY_IS_FOR_NEWER_CORE: The city is for a newer version of the core, please update it before retrying.
MIGRATION_ERROR_WRONG_MIGRATION_NAME: One of the migrations has a wrong name, it has to be fixed before the city can be updated.
MIGRATION_ERROR_MISSING_MIGRATIONS: A migration is missing, it has to be created before the city can be updated.

Proceed now?
CORE_NOT_FOUND: The core used by this city is not installed.
OBJ_LST_TOOLTIP:
Select an object to highlight it.
Use the up/down arrows to navigate the list.
CT_OUTER_PATCH_TOOLTIP:
These parameters affect the outer terrain patch only (i.e. the patch surrounding the entire city if all roads are interconnected)
Note: concave shapes will produce excess vertices breaking the perimeter, delete them to fix it
CT_OUTER_PATCH_FUSION_DISTANCE_TOOLTIP: External vertices closer than this to the others will be removed
CT_OUTER_PATCH_SEGMENT_LENGTH_TOOLTIP: The outer patch will be split in segments each approximately this long
CT_OUTER_PATCH_THICKNESS_TOOLTIP: The external patch is made of two sets of vertices: the road vertices, and a copy of those vertices extruded along the normal. Those external vertices will be extruded by this value
CT_INT_PT_DIST_TOOLTIP: If greater than zero, the patches will be filled with internal points this distant from each other (the points are determined through Poisson disk sampling)
TEX_SEL_LST_TOOLTIP:
Select a texture in this list to get a preview of it before applying it.
Use the up/down arrows to navigate the list.
MESH_SEL_LST_TOOLTIP:
To instantiate a mesh, select it from this list and click on any point in the world.
Use the up/down arrows to navigate the list.
TRANSF_P_SWITCH_SPACE_TOOLTIP: Switches from local to global space and vice versa (only affects the transformation gizmo)
BL_LIST_TOOLTIP: There is a building between each pair of dividing points (the first and last point count as such even if not explicitly set)
BS_FLOOR_LIST_TOOLTIP: These are the upper floors, the first X floors are placed at the bottom, the last Y are placed at the top, the remaining ones are placed at the middle, repeated if necessary (X is the low floors count, Y is the high floors count)
BS_BLOCK_LIST_TOOLTIP: These are the types of blocks used by the floors
BS_F_LIST_TOOLTIP: Each slice is a block repeated a specified number of times, each with a specified width (see the parameters below)
BS_F_GROUND_BLOCK_TOOLTIP: Only used for the ground floor
BS_F_GROUND_HEIGHT_TOOLTIP: If editing the ground floor: set 0 to make sliver-only (using only the top block)
BLDG_FIXACUTE_TOOLTIP: Can break long building lines, disable it if needed.
BL_PRESET_LIST_TOOLTIP: The autogenerated buildings will use presets chosen randomly from this list
PREF_GLOBAL_PATHS_TOOLTIP: Content in these folders will be available in all cities (in addition to content of the current city folder)
PREF_LOCAL_PATHS_TOOLTIP: Content in these folders will be available in the current city only (in addition to content of the current city folder)
OVERLAY_TOOLTIP: Example of usage: select a map to make it appear on the ground (the toggle is in the View menu), and then use it as a guide to place roads
TRANSF_P_SNAPTOGRID_TOOLTIP: If checked, when moving the point while holding the Shift key, the position will be snapped to the grid, if deselected, the Shift key will instead restrict the movement to increments of 1 (basically the same thing, but not aligned to the grid)
PROP_ELEM_RND_TOOLTIP: If unchecked, meshes are chosen sequentially, if checked, randomly.
RD_SW_RD_UV_TOOLTIP: Uses road-style UV coordinates for the sidewalks. Use sparingly, as it may look bad when the sidewalk does not have 4 distinct sides (e.g. when going from a road with sidewalks to another without them)
TE_CONTINUOUS_TOOLTIP: If checked, the modifier is applied while holding the left mouse button (by intensity/second), if unchecked it's applied once per click. (by intensity)
HIDE_OTHER_TOOLTIP: Hides/shows other entities of the same type as this one
PREF_SCRIPT_FOLDERS_TOOLTIP: The scripts (.py files, and folders with a script.json) in these folders are listed in the Scripts menu
VALIDATION_TOOLTIP:
The warnings and errors found by the exporter of the core.
Select one to highlight its element (if it has one).
VALIDATION_NOT_AVAILABLE: The core of the city has no exporter that can validate it.
PREF_MCP_ENABLED_TOOLTIP:
Lets AI agents (e.g. Claude Code) edit the open city through the Model Context Protocol.
Only local connections with the token are accepted.
PREF_MCP_TOKEN_TOOLTIP: The clients send it in the Authorization header (Bearer <token>)
PREF_MCP_COMMAND_TOOLTIP: Run it in a terminal to add the server to Claude Code
CE_NO_TYPES: The core has no custom element types
MI_NO_TYPES: The core has no mesh instance types
CE_CLICK_TO_CREATE: Click on the city to create the element
CE_RESTORE_SOURCE_TOOLTIP: Deletes the custom elements this element was converted to (with this one) and brings back the original element
CE_RESTORE_SOURCE_WARNING: Delete every custom element the original element was converted to, and bring it back?
CE_ON_COLUMN: on the vertical line of a point
CE_INSERT_TOOLTIP: Adds an element to the array containing the selected point, before or after its element (in arrays inside arrays, to the outer one: e.g. a section, not a lane)
CE_REMOVE_ELEMENT_TOOLTIP: Removes the element of the array containing the selected point (in arrays inside arrays, of the outer one: e.g. its section, not its lane), or the selected vertex of the mesh
CE_ADD_INNER_TOOLTIP: Adds an element after the one of the selected point to the inner array containing it (e.g. a lane, in every section)
CE_REMOVE_INNER_TOOLTIP: Removes the element of the selected point from the inner array containing it (e.g. its lane, in every section)
CE_DETACH_POINT_TOOLTIP: The selected point stops being shared with other elements (or stops following its anchor)
CE_MOVE_HANDLE_SELECTED: Moving the container with its contents
CE_NOT_IN_ARRAY_ERROR: The selected point is not in an array that can be edited
CE_ARRAY_FULL_ERROR: The array can't have more elements
CE_CANNOT_REMOVE_ERROR: The selected point can't be removed (it is not in an array that can be edited, or the array has its minimum number of elements)
CE_MERGE_TOOLTIP: Moves the contents of this element into another container, and deletes this one
CE_MERGE_ERROR: The contents of this element can't all be put in the chosen one
